description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, providing common logging setup and lifecycle management.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class extending FragmentActivity that provides logging initialization and lifecycle management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Override of the FragmentActivity's onCreate method, currently only calls super.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the onStart lifecycle method to initialize logging when the activity starts.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging mechanism by creating a LogWrapper and assigning it to Log, then logs a message indicating readiness.
